Milia/Maria is an UFS's flame magic user.

She has multiple personality disorder since her other name of Maria.


Advertisement
Personality
Milia is a rather diabolic women that uses her ability in brutal ways, known to burn churches and people alive. She is rude and enjoys fighting and killing, laughing like a maniac while burning people. Attacking in ways keeping her target alive as long as possible. She views her ability as a curse and curses god for it. Likewise, she is quite sexual and can change sights easily because of it. In short, a sadist.

She suffers from multiple personality disorders, and the other original personality within her is Maria.

Maria, a cheerful, pure-hearted, deeply religious girl who was a perfect example of a sister and pious person. She cries over Milia, wishing to remove her from the UFS, as working for them creates suffering for her. Maria acts like a sister to Milia and worries deeply for her. Other than Millia she is a devoted nun and strongly believes in god. Having created Milia as a way to excuse her own masochistic joy, from being forced into it by a priest in the past.

Milia hates Maria, however, claiming she is a slut that enjoys sex and just pushes her guilt away.

In the (what if) TABA event, Fuuma Kotaro is able to make both parts of her submit to him, ending their internal fight and reduces the destructiveness of Milia.



Appearance
She is a woman with a large bust, purple eyes and short red hair.

History
Background
She was abandoned by a church as a baby, in the year 2062, and does not know who her parents are and only her name, Maria.

"Maria" was raised in that church, and she became a perfect nun, which was very devoted. She has been aware of her power to control fire ever since she could remember, but she has warned herself that it is her power that goes against the teachings of God, and that she must never use it.

It was in the middle of the day, in Maria's heart is a swirling hatred for her parents and the society that abandoned her. This creates another personality, Milia. What's more, in that church, the priest was actually secretly committing fornication with the sisters, and the girls were called by the priest on the day they got their first period and were raped in the name of God. In the night "Maria" was raped by the priest and shed tears and begged for her forgiveness, but he didn't listen, and the moment she felt the terrible pain, her suppressed hatred exploded, and her devilish personality, Milia, was revealed, which took over her body.

When Miria wakes up, she uses her firepower without hesitation, burns the priest to death, and kills everyone else in the church in order to erase her former self, which has been covered in her lies. She burns all the sisters who walked the path of God together with her, including her sisters. That was when she was only 14 years old, year 2076. Six years have passed since then, year 2082, and the former star flame user has been affiliated with the UFS under the code name "Fanatic Flame" as an Exorcist.

Timeline TABA
Mentioned first as the Fanatical Flame to protect the interest of the UFS on Karutebara Beach. When Akiyama Rinko was investigating the island for foul play, the Fuuma Organization saw it as a way to take over the casino in the chaos, should UFS and Taimanin fight. However, it was a trap and Milia and Rinko worked together. Though defeated, no capture or dialog with either Rinko oir Milia takes place.

In her (what if) TABA event, Fuuma Kotaro is contacted by Maria and traps Milia in a church, to be forced out of the UFS as Milia hates to work for them. Kotaro takes away her fire ability and has sex with her, Maria now shocked about the development emerges, both "selves" argue while having sex.

Kotaro not knowing that Maria and Milia were the same person, having two personalities, was surprised but not deterrent. Able to convince Millia to join his group, as Maria admitted her own lust too.

Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Fire

Pyromancy: "Flame Magic" Able to create and control fire.
Fire Resistance: This ability remains even when her normal Flame magic is sealed or stolen.
Lesser Heal: Able to heal lesser burn wounds quick.

Trivia
Her real name would probably be Maria Clementine.
More information is given in TABA Artbook 1.
The exact origin of her powers is unknown, and it is not clear if she is a half demon, Taimanin, Exorcist or Esper in origin.
